{{Quote|Perhaps you don't know who I am?''"<br />"''Someone with an overinflated opinion of himself?|Benok and Meetra Surik|<ref name="KOTOR 2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
'''Benok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], and chief of security for [[Loppak Slusk]], head of operations for the [[Exchange]] on [[Citadel Station]] over [[Telos IV]].<ref name="KOTOR 2" />

==Biography==
[[File:Benokblaster.png|left|thumb|Benok's blaster]]
Making the most of his master dueling skills and giving every job his fullest attention, Benok worked his way quickly up the ladder of the [[Exchange]] on [[Citadel Station]] to become [[Loppak Slusk|Slusk's]] enforcer, impressing Slusk with his skill and attitude. He was cold, calculating, and arrogant, and was feared by opponents of the Exchange. Skillful with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], his own henchmen included [[Matu]] and [[Nahata]], two of the best and most ruthless Exchange thugs on Telos. Benok was highly praised on the Citadel Station for his [[Dueling|Master Dueling]] ability. Benok, while on Telos, threatened [[Meetra Surik]] in the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] only to be killed by her later as she [[Skirmishes on Citadel Station|stormed]] the Exchange offices. Wearing [[reinforced fiber armor]] for protection, Benok also had a [[Benok's blaster|custom blaster pistol]] with an additional ion cell, which Surik may have taken from Benok's body as a trophy after he was killed. The ion cell allowed it to deal damage to droids.
